description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced Data Center Curriculum Developer/Instructional Designer to join our fast-growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating instructional materials for the OCI Data Center Onboarding Program. Your remit will encompass OCI data centers across the U.S., with potential for global remit in the future.  

  

 Specific responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to): 
 Define and document learning objectives.
 Conduct research and collaborate with subject experts.
 Create instructional material: courses, curriculum, student guides or training manuals.
 Design content to optimize learning.
 Redesign content to ensure it matches the learner’s needs.
 Create visual, audio and interactive learning tools.
 Training will be a combination of eLearning, instructor-led, and on-the-job training. 
  
 Basic Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree
 6+ years of relevant experience in instructional design
 3+ years of project management experience 
 Highly skilled with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
 Highly skilled with learning authoring tools
 Ability to work in ambiguity, manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and deliver
 Proven track record of taking ownership and driving results
 Exceptional interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills and experience interacting with both business and development/engineering staff at all levels
  
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with cloud infrastructure services 
 Experience with data center onboarding and training
 Experience with video editing software
 Experience with Learning Management System administration
 Experience with cloud software and platform services
 Ability to think broadly and strategically
 Highly analytical, technically proficient, and able to learn new tools and software quickly
  
 #LI-RR2
